workers.name: thelingolegacyv-5
workers.notes: Cloudflare API confirms apex wildcard, www wildcard and 16 product/utility subdomain wildcard routes. Bare apex root is intercepted by the exact-root route; query-bearing apex-root URLs match this wildcard.

workers.name: lingo-flagship-root
workers.notes: Cloudflare API confirms exact route thelingolegacy.com/. Cloudflare route matching includes the query string, but route patterns cannot contain query parameters; therefore the exact route matches the bare root only, while a query-bearing root request falls through to the apex wildcard Worker. Runtime cf-ray/response-marker attribution remains unverified.

secret_binding_audit.method: Cloudflare Worker secrets binding-name list plus Worker settings bindings
secret_binding_audit.interpretation: No secret names were returned for the seven scripts. The settings endpoint exposes three non-secret bindings on thelingolegacyv-5 and no regular bindings on the other six. This is not a complete audit of account-level secret stores, service bindings, or external provider credentials.

route_inventory.source: Cloudflare zone Workers Routes API read-only snapshot
route_inventory.query_string_behavior: Route matching considers the entire request URL; patterns cannot include query parameters. Therefore the exact apex-root route does not match a root URL carrying a query string; the apex wildcard catches it.
